# numbers.json keys (generated by ml/write_results_md.py — do not edit by hand)

Keys that existed before the lab+field model keep their earlier meaning: they describe the **lab-only model**, now used as the new-region simulation (FIELD_ACC_NO_ABSTAIN, FIELD_MEAN_CONFIDENCE, FIELD_NOT_SURE, MITE_NOT_SURE, AUROC_*, COV_*, ACC_ANS_*, LAB_*, VILLAGE_* (lab-only + 50 labels operating point), DINO_*, HB_AI_*, HB_RUST_NAMED_AI, REF_KB (1,000-row lab-only reference), N_TRAIN (lab photos)). MODEL_MB and LATENCY_MS_LAPTOP describe files both models share. HEAD_KB is the size of the shipped head file. HB_HUMAN_* and HB_AGREE_* describe the two people and are unchanged.

## Keys re-pointed to head v3 (v3-2026-10-03-lab+field+other)

## Familiarity rule (`FAM_*`, from results/familiarity_rule.json, written by ml/eval_familiarity_rule.py)

Decision: **accept**, ood.local_nearest_cutoff = 0.494. Chosen on the DEV part (40% of the Ugandan coarse copy clusters), scored on the TEST part. Every Ugandan share counts each copy group once.

**Keys whose meaning changed with this rule.** The app now uses it, so every learning-loop key that simulates the app uses it too: `UG_LOOP*`, `UG_LABONLY_LOOP*`, `UG_COARSE_LOOP*`, `UG_APPRULE_LOOP*`, `EC_LOOP50_ANSWERED`, `COV_*`, `ACC_ANS_*` (the `*_LOCAL_ONLY` baselines too), the lab-only `VILLAGE_*` operating point and `HB_AI_UPD_*` (the lab-only demo update). The previous rule stays as `UG_PREVRULE_*` and `COV_*_PREV` / `ACC_ANS_*_PREV`. Removed: `UG_OPTION_*` and `UG_OPTION_COARSE_*` (the rule they simulated is now the app rule, up to a 0.00003 difference in the cutoff and the officer rows also joining the 10-nearest check); any doc sentence using them, or calling the "not sure" check slow in Uganda, needs rewording.

| Key | Value now | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `FAM_DECISION` | accept | decision on the rule (accept: in head.json and the app) |
| `FAM_C1` | 0.494 | ood.local_nearest_cutoff: a photo also counts as familiar when 1 - cosine to its nearest officer-labelled photo is at most this |
| `FAM_C1_FRACTION` | 1.0 | FAM_C1 as a multiple of the shipped familiarity cutoff (SHIP_CUTOFF) |
| `FAM_DEV_SHARE` | 40% | share of Ugandan coarse copy clusters used to choose FAM_C1 (DEV part); the rest is the TEST part |
| `FAM_DEV_GROUPS` | 546 | Ugandan copy groups in the DEV part |
| `FAM_TEST_GROUPS` | 805 | Ugandan copy groups in the TEST part |
| `FAM_FLOOR` | 85% | selection rule: photos the new rule adds must be at least this share correct at 10, 20, 50 and 100 labels (DEV part) |
| `FAM_FRACTION_MIN` | 0.2 | smallest candidate multiple tried |
| `FAM_FRACTION_MAX` | 1.0 | largest candidate multiple tried (larger values were not tested) |
| `FAM_DEV_ADDED_CORRECT` | 96–97% | DEV part, chosen FAM_C1: photos the new rule adds, share correct (range over 10, 20, 50, 100 labels) |
| `FAM_TEST_SEEDS` | 5 | random pool/scored splits and label orders on the TEST part |
| `FAM_HB_ANSWERED` | 50 | of them answered by the shipped model under both rules (no officer labels) |
| `FAM_HB_N` | 60 | human-baseline photos checked |
| `FAM_HB_SAME` | identical | decisions on those photos, new rule against previous rule |
| `FAM_MITE0_SENT` | 71% | mite photos sent to the officer by the shipped head before any officer label (optimistic: head v3 trained on most of them; the fair figure is SHIP_MITE_NOT_SURE) |
| `FAM_V2_MITE0_SENT` | 14% | same for head v2 (no "other" answer, never trained on mite photos) |
| `FAM_MITE_MAX_DROP` | 1.7 | largest drop, in points, in mite photos sent to the officer, new rule against previous rule (gate: at most 5) |
| `FAM_V2_MITE_MAX_DROP` | 2.0 | same with head v2 (stress test, not a gate) |
